resources.text: Sandbox notebook uses two separate observations: visible debris and reflected sheen. A sample may have no visible debris but still show low sheen. The demonstration compares dry sample D brushed for 4 minutes with sample W described as brushed for 2 minutes; W moisture condition is not recorded. These notes do not establish either a universal care rule or a duration effect. Creator may publish the narrow observation or hold the comparison; no physical treatment is authorized.
The catalog of bead colors is unrelated to the finishing comparison.
